description: The reference adapters: function-member, static-registry, skill-router, basic-topology, memory-execution, rule-attribution, the prototype host.
Agents read from registry.json by ./adapters/file-registry.ts instead of the configured members.
Members chosen by keyword overlap (./adapters/keyword-router.ts) instead of skill-router rules.
sequence and route run by ./adapters/linear-topology.ts instead of basic-topology.
Journal in JSON files (./adapters/file-execution.ts) instead of memory.
Journal in a SQLite file (sqlite-execution) at SWAP_SQLITE_PATH, a temp path, instead of memory.
Failures blamed on the last hop that did not complete (./adapters/last-failure-attribution.ts) instead of rule-attribution.
billing answered by another member adapter, ./adapters/table-member.ts over a JSON rule table, instead of function-member.
billing served by an agent-layers stack through the agent-layers member adapter.
billing served over A2A by a2a-member, against a fake A2A agent on loopback that the test starts (the command line has no agent to call).
The agent-layers host (identity, authorization, guard, eval) instead of the prototype host.
Every swap of this example at once: registry, routing, topology, execution (file), attribution, member (table) and host.
A run waits on the host gate before billing and is resumed by the same system on the memory journal.
A run waits on the host gate before billing and is resumed by a new system on the same file journal; triage replays.
A run waits on the host gate before billing and is resumed by a new system on the same SQLite journal; triage replays.
linear-topology with a loop topology: check refuses the kind before any run.
